jobs.title: Client Developer (Unity3D)
jobs.description:
**Experience Level:**  
Fresh Graduates to 3 Years
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an enthusiastic
  
  
Client Developer
  
  
(Fresh Grads to 3 years of experience) to join our team. Working directly with our designers, artists, and backend engineers, you’ll help build responsive UI, kinetic combat mechanics, and smooth client-side systems in Unity3D.
  
  
If you love mobile games, care deeply about how controls and UI feel to the player, and want to make a real impact at an agile indie studio, we’d love to talk to you.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
**Gameplay & Systems:**  
Write clean C# code to build and maintain core gameplay features, player controls, combat mechanics, and meta-game UI in Unity.
  
  
**UI Integration:**  
Work with UI/UX designers to bring wireframes from Miro and design tools to life in-game using Unity UI, focusing on smooth animations and responsive feedback.
  
  
**Game Polish:**  
Tweak and polish "game feel"—adding camera shake, hit-stop, particle triggers, and sound triggers to make combat feel crisp and satisfying.
  
  
**Performance & Optimization:**  
Profile and optimize mobile performance (frame rates, draw calls, memory usage) so our games run smoothly across a wide range of devices.
  
  
**API Integration:**  
Connect client systems with backend services for player saves, monetization features, and live game updates.
  
  
**Team Collaboration:**  
Participate in code reviews, bug fixing, and agile workflows using Jira and Confluence alongside our engineering and design leads.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
**Experience:**  
Fresh graduates in Computer Science, Game Design/Development, or candidates with 1–3 years of hands-on Unity3D experience.
  
  
**Core Technical Skills:**  
Strong foundation in C# programming, object-oriented concepts, and component-based design.
  
  
Practical experience with Unity UI, animator state machines, and physics/collision systems.
  
  
Good understanding of mobile optimization basics and profiling tools in Unity.
  
  
**Portfolio / Projects:**  
Demonstrable game projects (university portfolio, personal projects, game jam entries, or published titles) showing functional C# gameplay code.
  
  
**Mindset:**  
Strong problem-solving skills, eagerness to learn, and a passion for action/roguelite game mechanics.
  
  
Nice to Haves
  
  
Experience or interest in mobile action/roguelite titles (top-down combat, skill progression, auto-attack math).
  
  
Basic understanding of REST APIs, JSON parsing, or cloud save integration.
  
  
Familiarity with Unity Addressables or AssetBundles.
  
  
Experience with Git and collaboration tools like Miro, Jira, and Confluence
  
  
OneMT is a globally integrated net technology corporation dedicated to bringing the best in online entertainment to gamers the world over. Available in 18 languages, several OneMT games have consistently topped the charts on both iOS and Android in countries across the globe, and received the coveted Most Popular Games, and Best Game of the Year on the App Store and Google Play Store respectively - Revenge of Sultans being the most notable amongst them.
  
  
Operating from vibrant hubs in Beijing, Shanghai, Fuzhou, Dubai, and Singapore, OneMT deeply understands player preferences and delivers top-notch customer service tailored to the needs of our diverse player base.
  
  
With game development ethos based on the principles of 'One Life, One Love’, OneMT strives to develop products that bring fun, exciting entertainment and high-quality services to players everywhere.
  
  
OneMT is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth and development.

jobs.title: Salesforce Developer
jobs.description:
**Location:**  
Singapore
  
  
**Contract:**  
1-Year Contract
  
  
Job Description
  
  
We are seeking for a Salesforce Developer to design, develop, integrate, and enhance Salesforce solutions, with a strong focus on Service Cloud on behalf of our client. The successful candidate will work closely with clients, business stakeholders, and technical teams to deliver scalable and high-quality Salesforce implementations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Develop and customize Salesforce solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce Flows.
  
  
Support and enhance Salesforce Service Cloud implementations.
  
  
Design and implement integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and integration platforms.
  
  
Perform data migration, transformation, and validation using tools such as Data Loader and ETL platforms.
  
  
Configure and maintain Salesforce security, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and access controls.
  
  
Develop reports, dashboards, and analytics to support business and operational requirements.
  
  
Collaborate directly with clients, business users, and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  
  
Provide solution consulting and pre-sales support, including technical discussions, solution design, and client presentations where required.
  
  
Follow Salesforce engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, code quality, observability, documentation, and knowledge transfer.
  
  
Troubleshoot production issues and provide ongoing technical support and enhancements.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Hands-on experience as a Salesforce Developer, with substantial experience in Salesforce Service Cloud implementations.
  
  
Salesforce Platform Developer certification or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Strong development experience with Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Flows.
  
  
Proven experience with Salesforce integrations, including REST/SOAP APIs and middleware.
  
  
Strong understanding of data migration processes and tools, including Data Loader and/or ETL tools.
  
  
Good knowledge of Salesforce administration and security configuration.
  
  
Experience developing Salesforce reports and dashboards.
  
  
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working directly with clients and business users.
  
  
Experience supporting pre-sales, solution consulting, or technical solution design is highly desirable.
  
  
Familiarity with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, documentation, and engineering best practices for large-scale Salesforce implementations.
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
Experience with Salesforce OmniStudio and OmniScript.
  
  
Experience working on large-scale or enterprise Salesforce transformation projects.
  
  
Additional Salesforce certifications.
  
  
Experience with Salesforce DevOps and deployment tools.

jobs.title: Java API Development with Integration Experience
jobs.description:
**Primary Skills:**  
Java API Development, Integration
  
  
**Additional Skills:**  
Basic knowledge of C#/.NET
  
  
**Job Description:**  
ASRS Integration Engineer x1
  
  
**Focus:** Automated Storage & Retrieval Systems.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities:**  
Develop software interfaces for high-capacity Automated Storage & Retrieval Systems (ASRS) used for storing incoming materials and finished goods. Ensure seamless integration of ASRS units with factory control systems and the MES for real-time inventory updates and retrieval requests. Implement control logic for associated material handling equipment (e.g. automated pallet conveyors, lifters interfacing with the ASRS), handling equipment commands and acknowledgments. Optimize throughput and reliability for material movements between the ASRS and production lines.
  
  
**Must Have Skills:**  
Experience integrating warehouse automation systems (ASRS) into manufacturing operations, including understanding of conveyor systems and inventory management workflows. Proficiency in programming for real-time equipment control (e.g. using C#/.NET or
  
  
Java
  
  
To interface with storage system controllers and handle low-latency data exchange. Familiarity with systems integration techniques to connect equipment software with MES/ERP transactions (ensuring inventory updates occur in real time).
  
  
**Good to Have Skills:**  
Knowledge of PLC communication and industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, etc.) for interfacing with ASRS and related machinery. Understanding of warehouse operations and material flow optimization, enabling design choices that improve automated storage/retrieval efficiency and reliability.
